profile.headline: Principal Engineer at Palo Alto Networks

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Core contributor for OpenTelemetry, a CNCF backed project standardizing the way traces and metrics are captured. Co-organized the JavaScript SIG. Early OpenTracing contributor.
• Latency Metrics - built out a time-series system for LightStep’s latency histograms.
• Satellite - LightStep’s data ingest and primary analysis point. Overhauled the
internals leading to an order of magnitude of performance improvement and increasing observability of on prem satellites.
• Product Features: Data Insights, Query Builder, Developer Mode, Snapshots,
Historical Histograms, and SAML SSO.
• Built tools and integrations for Sales/CS: Demo environment, Grafana plugin,
Embeddable charts, splunk logs to span

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Created an CLI tool to interact with IronMQ (their distributed message queue).
* Worked on our consensus algorithm and inhouse database for IronMQ.
* Created and worked on a thorough set of benchmarks comparing our message queue product to RabbitMQ http://www.iron.io/blog/2015/08/ironmq-v3-is-10x-faster-than-rabbitmq.html
* Built a PoC lock free priority queue for IronMQ
* Rewrote out backend usage and metrics system using Riemann and InfluxDB.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Worked on log analysis tool which gave customers context and meaningful analysis of large test log sets. 
Wrote firmware and automated test software for In-Circuit Test Fixtures.
